extension.description: Living state-machine documentation for Rust + Crux applications, beside the code.
command.show.title: Show State Machines
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Analyzing a folder means running the crux-analyzer binary over its sources, so the folder has to be trusted.
config.binary: Path to the crux-analyzer binary (default: resolved on PATH). Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot choose which executable runs.
config.src: Directory with the Rust sources to analyze, relative to the workspace root — it must stay inside it. Empty tries shared/src, then src.
config.projectName: Project name shown in the panel. Empty uses the workspace folder name.
config.watch: Regenerate the model whenever a .rs file under the analyzed directory is saved.
